description: First architecture comparison (handoff P4): the existing planner (A0) against one local model choosing read-only tools (A1), on the same agent_bench cases, model and machine.

A0.context: one snapshot of relevant records, chosen by Rust (planner_candidates), plus spare-time facts when the request hands over the choice of a day
A0.generation: as in the app: temperature 0, think off, 8192-token context window

A1.catalog: built-in v0 read tools (same names and arguments as the benchmark's tool definitions)
A1.contextNote: A1 gets a 16384-token window to match its context budget, since tool results accumulate over steps; A0 sends one prompt into the app's 8192-token window.
A1.budget: each case's own budget (benchmark defaults: 12 model calls, 12 tool calls, 120 s, 16384 context tokens)

scoring.outcome: every check except the tool-process ones (required tools, order, calls and call limits); applies to both architectures
scoring.full: every check, as agent_bench scores it; A1 only, since A0 makes no tool calls
scoring.a0NotApplicableWhen: the case injects tool errors or tool responses, or changes state between tool calls: those test behaviour between reads, and A0 does not read
scoring.caseVerdict: a case counts as solved when at least 2 of 3 repeats succeed
